# Secure Business AI

Secure Business AI helps small businesses onboard securely to AI with plain-English education, practical reviews, AI readiness support, voice reception, website chat, and guided implementation.

## Services

### Secure AI Onboarding

Guided setup for small businesses that want to adopt AI without exposing sensitive information, confusing staff, or buying disconnected tools.

### AI Starter Guide

A plain-English digital guide for business owners who want to understand what AI is, where to start, and what to avoid.

### AI Readiness Pack

A $495 one-time service that prepares website-ready AI/search support files and content, including llms.txt guidance, business facts copy, schema support, robots additions, and install notes.

### AI Website Review

A practical review of website clarity, lead capture, AI search readiness, customer response gaps, and suitable improvement options.

### AI Voice Receptionist

AI phone answering and enquiry capture for businesses missing calls or spending too much staff time on basic customer questions.

### Website + AI Chatbot

A stronger digital front door with website chat, lead capture, customer answers, and practical handover to the business.

### AI Business Bundle

A coordinated setup across website, chatbot, voice reception, and secure rollout, so a business has one provider instead of five disconnected tools.
